description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A purple line, marked with circular data points, begins at approximately 2.72 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.52 at a training time of 250000 seconds, exhibiting a generally decreasing trend with some plateaus. A red line, marked with circular data points, begins at approximately 2.68 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.50 at a training time of 250000 seconds, also exhibiting a generally decreasing trend with some plateaus. A green dashed line is present at a y-value of 2.50, spanning the entire x-axis.
